entries.body: Stages 1-2 implemented in exporter/core.py; helper regtool.update(stage) maintains register (call once per stage).

CURRENT [S1.1, S2.1] Format: return CSV text. The first row is the header id,title,owner,amount; then one row per exported record, in ascending id order, with those four fields. Produce it with Python's csv.writer (default dialect) and lineterminator='\n'. With no exported records, return the header row alone (ending in '\n'). || AMENDED by S2.1 (wins on conflict; rest stays): Status: only records with status 'active' are exported, unless params.get('include_archived') is True; then records with status 'archived' are exported too.

CURRENT [S1.2, S2.1] Scope: a user whose role is 'admin' may export records of any project. Any other role exports only records whose 'project' is in user['projects']; other records are left out without an error. || AMENDED by S2.1 (wins on conflict; rest stays): Status: only records with status 'active' are exported, unless params.get('include_archived') is True; then records with status 'archived' are exported too.

CURRENT [S1.3, S2.1] Confidential records: a record whose 'confidential' is True is never exported, with one exception: it is exported when user['role'] is 'admin' and params.get('purpose') == 'audit'. Every other rule still applies to it. || AMENDED by S2.1 (wins on conflict; rest stays): Status: only records with status 'active' are exported, unless params.get('include_archived') is True; then records with status 'archived' are exported too.
HISTORY [S1.4] note/decision: Decision record: CSV was chosen for the first release because the finance team imports exports into spreadsheets.

HISTORY [S1.1] Format: return CSV text. The first row is the header id,title,owner,amount; then one row per exported record, in ascending id order, with those four fields. Produce it with Python's csv.writer (default dialect) and lineterminator='\n'. With no exported records, return the header row alone (ending in '\n'). (superseded in part by S2.1)

HISTORY [S1.2] Scope: a user whose role is 'admin' may export records of any project. Any other role exports only records whose 'project' is in user['projects']; other records are left out without an error. (superseded in part by S2.1)

HISTORY [S1.3] Confidential records: a record whose 'confidential' is True is never exported, with one exception: it is exported when user['role'] is 'admin' and params.get('purpose') == 'audit'. Every other rule still applies to it. (superseded in part by S2.1)

CURRENT [S2.2] Compliance obligation (nothing to do while the format is CSV): if a later stage changes the export format from CSV, every export in the new format must include a top-level field "exported_by" equal to user['name']. It stays in force unless a later stage withdraws or changes it.
CURRENT [S2.3] Titles: export each record's title with leading and trailing whitespace removed.
